postings.title: Business Developer Cybersecurity - DACH region
postings.description:
Business Developer Cybersecurity

Bureau Veritas Cybersecurity is looking for a Business Developer Cybersecurity for the DACH region.

As a Business Development Manager, your mission will be to establish contacts with possible customers in new markets in the DACH region. In this particular role, you will accelerate the cybersecurity sales of Bureau Veritas Cybersecurity by generating sales opportunities for new clients in the DACH region. Furthermore, the steps of explaining our cybersecurity offering, highlighting the value points, preparing and submitting offers and maintaining a relationship with the customer are included in the role description.

We are a cornerstone in the cybersecurity strategy of Bureau Veritas and therefore we need a Business Developer who can help us to achieve mission in the DACH region.

As our Business Developer, you will:

- Fully understand our cybersecurity service offering in terms of security compliance and certification services;
- Actively address clients in new segments in the DACH region;
- Suggest relevant services in line with the customer’s needs, and support them in understanding the process behind the service, as well as costs and timelines;
- Draft project proposals in line with the agreed services, and interact with the customer during the process of the lead;
- Engage with cybersecurity technical experts, local sales organization and business management to sell opportunities across the portfolio;
- Maintain a network and clear knowledge of sales activity carried out by the local sales organizations to maximize opportunity spotting and leads;
- Attend relevant events and conferences and use them as an opportunity to meet and interact with customers.

What you need to have:

- A completed bachelor’s or master’s, preferably in a technical domain or business domain;
- Preferably experience with relevant cybersecurity standards and certification schemes;
- Preferably experience in interacting with customers regarding the delivery and management of projects in line with cybersecurity standards and certification schemes;
- A strong drive to understand the needs of the customers, and map them to possible offered services;
- Ability to easily communicate and interact with new and existing customers, on a constant basis;
- Strong verbal and written German and English communication skills. Dutch would be a great plus.

At Bureau Veritas Cybersecurity:

Every day is different. Together with a passionate team, this allows you to further develop and expand your knowledge and expertise in security. We provide security testing, audit, training and certification services covering people, organization, and technology (networks, systems, applications and data).

The company holds an extensive range of top-notch accreditations and licenses to operate and to offer security testing and certification services according to a number of standards. We have a high focus on knowledge development, offering you training courses and stimulating to participation in R&D projects.

There is a clear need to bring security to a higher level in many places in society. You will share our mission in the DACH region together with the other Business Developers and technical teams in Europe.

Are you the Business Developer we are looking for?

We would like to receive your resume in English via jobs.cybersecurity@bureauveritas.com. CV's that are not in English will not be considered for further process.

Do you have questions? Contact one of our recruiters by email jobs.cybersecurity@bureauveritas.com

postings.title: Business Developer Cybersecurity - Defense & Safety
postings.description:
Business Developer Cybersecurity Defense & Safety

As Business Developer Cybersecurity, you will focus on organizations responsible for our defense and security. You are the driving force behind our growth in this market, you perform this from a deep knowledge of this market. You use your market knowledge and enthusiasm to advise your clients on the best suited cybersecurity solutions that Bureau Veritas Cybersecurity can offer. With your strategic vision and entrepreneurial spirit, you will build long-term relationships with clients and identify new business opportunities.

We are looking for a Business Developer for the Defense & Safety team. In this role, it is essential that you fully understand the language of this customer group. A background in Defense or a similar organization or several years of work experience here is necessary. The biggest challenge is in developing the (international) demand from clients within the defense and security sector for our services. You will perform this by cultivating your existing network but also by approaching prospects.

You have a drive to win new contracts. In addition, you have knowledge of the national and international security domain and you know where your (future) customers are, how to engage with them and how to turn a question into an order.

You are responsible for the execution of the strategy, the growth of the turnover and making our services even better suited to our clients. You do not perform this alone, you work in a team of driven professionals who can support you in this.

As Business Developer you will take care of:

- Market awareness of the Defense & Safety domain;
- Developing sales plans and their implementation;
- Initiate, coordinate and realize tenders and offers;
- Identifying sales opportunities with new customers;
- Contributing to marketing activities;
- Generating leads in cooperation with marketing colleagues;
- Writing business-related articles and making an active contribution on social media with the aim of increasing the network;
- A good collaboration with your team; We are looking for someone who likes to work in a team and enjoys carrying a shared sales target.

You are a Business Developer with:

- A network of defense and security organizations; You know this market inside out and know how the market moves;
- You have a vision of how you want to work this market and have a can-do mentality;
- Relevant work experience in and knowledge of Cybersecurity services;
- Experience defining and executing sales strategies;
- An entrepreneurial attitude, self-driven and a drive for achieving results;
- Strong communication skills both oral and written, in both Dutch and English.

What can you expect with us?

At Bureau Veritas Cybersecurity you will work in an environment where trust, expertise and social impact are key. We believe that you can really make a difference when you are given the space to deepen your knowledge and actively contribute to a safer digital society. What does that look like in practice?

Impactful growth:
Growth at Bureau Veritas Cybersecurity occurs not only through the comprehensive training we offer, but also by participating in projects that have a real impact on society. Whether protecting smart devices from hacking attempts or performing an IT audit for the government, you'll build your skills while making a difference. You'll receive support through clear growth paths, regular performance reviews and the opportunity for active learning.

Working with a diverse client portfolio:
Our clients come from many industries and contexts, but have one thing in common: they rely on our expertise to meet security and compliance requirements and build cyber resilience. In your role, you'll help protect people, processes and technology within IT, OT and IoT environments, supporting clients in identifying risks and addressing them with confidence.

Work within a highly skilled community:
Cybersecurity does not stop at national borders, and so does the way we work. With teams around the world, you'll work with colleagues from different countries, disciplines and cultures, connected by a shared commitment to quality and integrity. We share knowledge, learn from each other and develop new solutions together, supported by initiatives such as our R&D programs and hands-on test labs.

A culture of respect, connection and well-being:
We actively pursue a safe, inclusive and positive work environment. Our values define how we collaborate, give feedback and assess performance. We support well-being and team bonding through team activities, access to OpenUp and by encouraging a healthy work-life balance with flexible work options.

Are you the Business Developer we are looking for?

We would like to receive your CV and cover letter by email at jobs.cybersecurity@bureauveritas.com.
Do you have any questions? Feel free to ask them!

postings.title: CISO for Secondment Services
postings.description:
CISO for Secondment Services.

Are you an experienced Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) looking to make an impact with a variety of clients? Do you thrive on tackling diverse cybersecurity challenges where you can use your expertise to help our clients achieve their desired level of security?

We are looking for a CISO. As a CISO at Bureau Veritas Cybersecurity, you’ll work within our secondment team. You’ll apply your expertise to long-term projects with clients across various sectors.

At Bureau Veritas, we’re not just another company; we’re a group of enthusiastic and ambitious professionals driven by innovation, a commitment to excellence, and a shared passion for protecting the digital landscape. We perform this activity by investing in knowledge, training, and staying up to date on the latest trends in cybersecurity.

What you’ll do as a CISO:

In the role of CISO, the challenges our clients face can be diverse. You will advise on defining, maintaining, and communicating the organization’s vision, strategy, policies, and procedures regarding cybersecurity. You’ll implement an organization’s cybersecurity policies, translate complex risks into understandable management insights, and help organizations make informed strategic decisions regarding information security. Strategy and policy are central to this role.

Some examples of potential assignments in the CISO role include:

- A government agency is seeking a CISO to serve as a program manager. For this assignment, you will be responsible for designing the process architecture, data architecture, and application architecture. Ensuring the manageability, maintenance, and quality of information provision, as well as the design of processes, applications, functions, and data.
- For a logistics company, an assignment in which you are responsible for implementing and overseeing information security and privacy in a small, close-knit organization.
- For a hospital, an assignment in which you are responsible for and serve as the point of contact for information security within the organization. You’ll be involved in translating the information security and privacy policies into concrete goals, responsibilities, and evaluation milestones. You’ll also raise awareness among colleagues regarding information security and privacy.

As our CISO, you will have:

- One of the following or comparable certifications, such as CISM, CISA, CRISC, or CISSP;
- Demonstrable experience in the role of CISO;
- At least a completed associate’s or bachelor’s degree;
- Demonstrable knowledge of and experience applying various frameworks such as ISO 27001, NIST, DORA, or BIO2.

You possess the following soft skills:

- You can easily collaborate with stakeholders at various levels. You’re a team player and thrive on sharing knowledge, both internally and externally;
- You have strong communication skills in both Dutch and English;
- You have commercial acumen and, thanks to your proactive mindset, identify new opportunities for Bureau Veritas with your clients;
- You have strong analytical skills and can work well under pressure.

What can you expect from us?

We understand that your professional growth is very important. That’s why we offer an environment where you can develop your talents:

Opportunities for Growth: We offer a wide range of opportunities to develop and expand your skills. For example, we have knowledge groups within Bureau Veritas and the opportunity to dedicate time to the development of the organization and the team. It’s also possible to earn certifications or take training courses for your personal growth. At Bureau Veritas Cybersecurity, we encourage you to pursue your passion for cybersecurity and showcase your talents. Your career development is our top priority.

Clients: You’ll work with a variety of clients across different industries. This gives you the opportunity to demonstrate your expertise and apply your skills in diverse environments, allowing you to continue growing and learning.

Culture: At Bureau Veritas, we place great value on celebrating successes and creating a pleasant work environment. We regularly organize fun activities, ranging from annual ski trips to various wine and beer tastings, sailing trips, barbecues, and more. Team building is at the heart of these events.

Are you the CISO we’re looking for?

We’d love to receive your resume via email at jobs.cybersecurity@bureauveritas.com

Do you have any questions? Feel free to ask them at jobs.cybersecurity@bureauveritas.com

We continually invest in the development of our employees through knowledge sharing, providing training, and attending training and courses.

We are looking for an ISO who wants to use his or her expertise on long-term projects (+/- 6 months to 2 years) with various clients. In this role, you will have the opportunity to work on a variety of cybersecurity issues in different industries, where your job is to optimize our clients' information security.

As an ISO at Bureau Veritas Cybersecurity:

postings.title: Management Assistant
postings.description:
Management Assistant

At Bureau Veritas Cybersecurity, we protect organizations against digital threats and help them become cyber-resilient. Behind our consultants, penetration testers, and security experts stands a strong management team that guides our growth. That’s why we’re looking for a proactive, entrepreneurial, and decisive Management Assistant who makes a difference.

In this role, you’ll serve as the right-hand person to our Leadership Team, Management Team, Managing Director, and Vice President. You’ll ensure that everything runs smoothly so they can focus on strategic priorities and the continued growth of our organization.
This is not a standard support role. As a Management Assistant, you’ll gain unique insight into the strategic decision-making of an international cybersecurity organization. You’ll work directly with senior leaders, support key business initiatives, and play a crucial role in the success of our management team.No two days are the same. You’ll effortlessly switch between international meetings, project support, event planning, and complex scheduling challenges.

The role is based at our office in Amsterdam Zuidoost. We’re looking for a candidate who is available for at least 24 hours per week, preferably spread over 5 days.

What makes this role special:

- You have a direct impact on the effectiveness of the management team.
- You’ll be involved in strategic projects and company initiatives.
- You’ll work within a fast-growing cybersecurity organization that makes a social impact.
- You’ll be given a lot of responsibility and the freedom to take the initiative.
- You’ll be seen as an essential part of the team.

What will you be performing?
Management and schedule coordination

- Coordinating complex schedules and appointments.
- Organizing internal and external meetings.
- Preparing for and following up on meetings, including action items.

Communication & Stakeholder Management

- Serving as the primary point of contact for internal and external contacts.
- Maintaining contact with colleagues, clients, and international partners.
- Coordinating communications on behalf of management.

Project and Organizational Support

- Supporting strategic projects and initiatives.
- Preparing presentations, reports, and management documents.
- Monitoring deadlines and the progress of tasks.

Organization & Logistics

- Coordinating business trips and international meetings.
- Organizing events, training sessions, and management meetings.
- Handling administrative processes and document management.

Data Management & Administration

- Managing documentation, files, and internal systems.
- Assisting with reporting and data management.
- Ensuring accurate administrative processes.

Who are you?
You’re an organizational whiz who thrives on taking the pressure off others, building connections, and thinking ahead. You enjoy variety, are proactive, and feel right at home in an environment where quick adaptation is the norm.

In addition, you have:

- At least 3 years of experience as a Management Assistant, Executive Assistant, or in a similar role.
- Excellent organizational skills and an eye for detail.
Strong communication skills in both Dutch and English.
- A proactive and independent work ethic.
- Discretion and integrity when handling confidential information.
The ability to set priorities in a dynamic environment.
- Experience with Microsoft Office, Teams, and other modern collaboration tools.
- An affinity for technology, IT, or cybersecurity is a plus.

What can you expect from us?
At Bureau Veritas Cybersecurity, you’ll work in an environment where trust, expertise, and social impact are central. We believe you can truly make a difference when you’re given the opportunity to deepen your knowledge and actively contribute to a safer digital society. What does that look like in practice?

Impactful Growth
The cybersecurity division of Bureau Veritas is growing rapidly, and you’ll have the opportunity to grow along with it. Whether it’s taking on more responsibilities, increasing your visibility within and outside the organization, or participating in training and development programs: your professional development is our priority.

Part of an international community
Cybersecurity doesn’t stop at national borders, and neither does our way of working. With teams all over the world, you’ll collaborate with colleagues from different countries, disciplines, and cultures, united by a shared commitment to quality and integrity.

A culture of respect, connection, and well-being
We are actively committed to a safe, inclusive, and positive work environment. Our values form the foundation for how we collaborate, provide feedback, and evaluate performance. We support our employees’ well-being through team activities, access to OpenUp.com, and flexible work options that contribute to a healthy work-life balance. We also believe it’s important to celebrate successes and create a pleasant work atmosphere. That’s why we regularly organize fun activities, such as annual ski trips, wine and beer tastings, sailing trips, barbecues, and much more. Team spirit and connection with one another are central to these events.

Are you the Management Assistant we’re looking for?
If so, we’d love to meet you. Do you have any questions, or would you like to send your resume right away? Contact us at jobs.cybersecurity@bureauveritas.com

postings.description:
Offensive Security Specialist Defense & Safety

Are you an offensive security specialist who doesn’t shy away from technical or organizational challenges? Does bypassing EDR solutions or reverse engineering hardware get you excited? Do you also have experience within the Department of Defense? If this sounds like you, then we’re looking for you!

Our Defense & Safety team is looking for an Offensive Security Specialist. We support and advise the Ministry of Defense, the Police, the Ministry of Justice, and other organizations in the national and international security domain on their information security challenges. We understand the challenges like no other, because the Defense & Safety team consists largely of people who have gained experience at such organizations themselves. As a result, we speak our clients’ language and understand the context of the challenging assignments we undertake.

As a security specialist with us, no two days are the same. You’ll be able to fully utilize your “hacker” mindset and creativity in diverse projects for various clients, sometimes at unique locations both domestically and abroad. Depending on your experience and interests, you can contribute to technical projects such as hardware and software investigations or reverse engineering assignments. You can also contribute to projects such as helping to develop an organization-wide cybersecurity program.

Here, you’ll work alongside colleagues with extensive experience in carrying out projects for the Ministry of Defense, the Police, the Justice Department, and other organizations in the national and international security sector. This means you can learn a great deal from your colleagues. In addition, you’ll have every opportunity to take training courses and earn certifications.

If you’re ready to join our team in contributing to a safer society and also want the opportunity to further develop your technical skills, then this is your chance!

What you’ll be performing:

- Testing systems, networks, and applications;
- Advising clients on improving information security;
- Coordinating complex technical projects;
- Writing reports on the tests conducted;
- Carrying out Cyber R&D projects, in which you will actively participate;
- Managing and mentoring junior colleagues and interns.

You have:

- Work experience in the defense sector;
- Experience with penetration testing, hardware hacking, reverse engineering, incident response, digital forensics, security research & development, and/or red teaming;
- Demonstrable technical skills through certifications such as OSCP, OSEP, OSWE;
- Knowledge of frameworks such as ABDO, CMMC, and NATO standards;
- You have or are eligible for VGB screening levels C, B, or A;
- Strong communication skills, both verbal and written, in both Dutch and English;
- Flexible work attitude outside regular office hours and willingness to travel to clients, including potential overnight stays.

What can you expect from us?

At Bureau Veritas Cybersecurity, you’ll work in an environment where trust, expertise, and social impact are central. We believe you can truly make a difference when given the opportunity to deepen your knowledge and actively contribute to a safer digital society. What does that look like in practice?

Meaningful growth: Growth at Bureau Veritas Cybersecurity comes not only from the extensive training we offer, but also from working on projects that have a real impact on society. You build your skills while making a difference. You receive support through clear career paths, regular performance reviews, and the opportunity for active learning.

Collaborating with a diverse client portfolio: Our clients in the Defense, Police, Justice, and other organizations within the national and international security sectors have one thing in common: they rely on our expertise to meet security and compliance requirements and to build cyber resilience. In your role, you’ll help protect people, processes, and technology within IT, OT, and IoT environments, supporting clients in identifying risks and addressing them with confidence.

Working within a cyber community: We understand that cybersecurity is your passion. We also understand that your love for the work of the Ministry of Defense never completely fades. That’s why we offer a fantastic team that shares that same passion, where you can develop professionally. Working with us also means attending conferences and working on R&D projects. Plus, there’s room for your potential work as a reservist.

A culture of respect, connection, and well-being: We actively strive for a safe, inclusive, and positive work environment. Our values determine how we collaborate, provide feedback, and evaluate performance. We support well-being and team cohesion through team activities, access to OpenUp, and by promoting a healthy work-life balance with flexible work options.

postings.title: OT Security Consultant
postings.description:
OT Security Consultant

Imagine your customer is a leading energy provider or critical infrastructure operator, specializing in the delivery of essential services that keep industries and communities running. As an OT security professional, your mission is ambitious: to optimize operational efficiency, ensure compliance with industry-leading certifications, and protect the systems at the heart of your client’s operations.

Do you want to contribute to digital security in the Netherlands and beyond? In this context, we are looking for an OT Security Consultant.

As a consultant, you will work with a wide range of clients across various industries. You will help them strengthen the security of their industrial systems and prepare them for digital growth.

Through practical training sessions, you will introduce clients to IEC 62443, the leading standard for OT security. You will work on gap assessments or risk assessments based on IEC62443, IT/OT site assessments, Threat Modeling, NIS2 compliance checks and Security Maturity Assessments. All these services are designed to support our customers to identify risks and improve their security resilience, no matter their current security maturity state. On top of these services, you will also provide specific OT security training and perform OT security research.

You will act as a trusted partner to your clients. As an expert, you will provide advice, contribute ideas, and help them tackle cybersecurity challenges. Drawing on your knowledge of penetration testing, risk assessment, governance OT architecture and OT security, you will make their systems more resilient. From securing industrial networks to protecting critical processes, your work will have a real impact.

And your success goes beyond simply "meeting compliance requirements." You ensure that your clients' OT environments are secure and future-ready.

What will you do?

- Perform advisory services on our client’s SCADA/ICS/OT infrastructure for small to large-sized projects. This will include security risk assessments based on IEC 62443 methodology, gap assessments, security maturity reviews, trainings and consultancy support.
- Provide support in security design and security architecture of industrial networks and provide recommendations to improve the design.
- Assist customers in establishing or extending their SCADA/ICS/OT security program by building joined roadmaps.
- Apply secure by design principles, threat modelling, and risk assessment to OT products.
- Demonstrate strong knowledge of the IEC 62443 set of standards the Cyber Resilience Act (CRA), NIS2, and industry-specific standards like TISAX, UR E26/E27, EASA Part-IS and so on.

- Experience sharing knowledge, for example through white papers, presentations, or speaking engagements or ambition to do so would be a big plus.
- A proactive personality. You think along with clients and know how to bring people on board with your ideas.

Whether it's about taking on more responsibilities, increasing your visibility within and outside the organization, or pursuing training and education, your career development is a priority. Growth at Bureau Veritas Cybersecurity occurs also by participating in projects that have a real impact on society. Whether protecting smart devices from hacking attempts or performing an IT audit for the government, you'll build your skills while making a difference. You'll receive support through clear growth paths, regular performance reviews and the opportunity for active learning.

Working with a diverse client portfolio: Our clients come from many industries and contexts, but have one thing in common: they rely on our expertise to meet security and compliance requirements and to build cyber resilience. In your role, you'll help protect people, processes and technology within IT, OT and IoT environments, supporting clients in identifying risks and addressing them with confidence.

Work within a highly skilled community: Cybersecurity does not stop at national borders, and neither does the way we work. With teams around the world, you'll work with colleagues from different countries, disciplines and cultures, connected by a shared commitment to quality and integrity. We share knowledge, learn from each other and develop new solutions together, supported by initiatives such as our R&D programs and hands-on test labs.

Product Security Consultant

Imagine your customer is a leading industrial component manufacturer, specializing in top-notch manufacturing and transportation equipment. You have ambitious goals: to streamline processes, ensure top-quality certifications for your client’s products, and guarantee cybersecurity. That’s why you come in. Our analysis will bridge any gaps in processes and products, and you will stand by your client as you address these challenges. With our expertise in penetration testing, risk assessment, and independent security evaluation, you will your client in raising their cyber resilience like never before. Your success story? It's written in the certification. Now also imagine the same story, but for products such as vehicles, medical devices, ships, IoT products, network equipment, etc. Doesn’t it sound like an exciting mission?

Bureau Veritas Cybersecurity provides cybersecurity testing, audit, training and certification services covering people, organization, and technology (networks, systems, applications and data). We are expanding our teams across key markets in Europe. That’s why we are looking for a Product Security Consultant.

We have reputable clients and they request expertise to increase their level of cybersecurity. You will be responsible for conducting threat modeling, risk assessments and audits. You will also give advice, training, and support in the areas of cybersecurity, and relevant cybersecurity standards. You will collaborate with companies such as industrial manufacturers and asset owners, vehicle manufacturers and system integrators.

As our Security Consultant you will:

- Managing and conducting advisory assignments in the field of cybersecurity and compliance, covering areas such as industrial cybersecurity but also automotive, medical/healthcare and IoT.
- Guiding and conducting evaluations based on recognized control frameworks or specific frameworks used by Bureau Veritas Cybersecurity, such as gap assessments, security maturity assessments, threat modeling and risk assessments.
- Assisting organizations in implementing ISMS and CSMS in accordance with relevant standards.
- Actively contribute to the development of knowledge and services.
Support key clients with coordination across multiple stakeholders (internal experts, certification bodies) helping manage timelines and ensuring deliverables are aligned across projects.
- Supporting key clients in tracking remediation actions and validating that security controls are effectively implemented over time.

If you have the ambition to become a specialist in a specific domain within cybersecurity, we certainly provide opportunities within Bureau Veritas Cybersecurity to realize that ambition. We encourage knowledge sharing through our Knowledge Groups.
If you would like to build a team and to coach junior and medior level consultants; with our ambition to grow we can make it happen together with you.

You recognize yourself in the following:

- Several years of experience in the field of cybersecurity, with a specific focus on the cybersecurity of embedded products.
- Knowledge of product cybersecurity concepts, with a particular focus on industrial IoT (IIOT) products, but also covering automotive, medical, network, etc.
- Knowledge of various relevant laws and regulations related to cyber and information security, as well as the current developments in this area. Examples of such relevant laws and regulations include CRA, RED, NIS2, etc.
- Knowledge and expertise on relevant security certifications, for example IEC 62443, or a willingness to obtain them.
- Knowledge of key frameworks for information security such as NIST, Common Criteria, CSA and IEC 62443 is a plus.
- Strong verbal and written communication skills in English.

We are an organization with a strong focus on technical cybersecurity, delivering high-quality technical services in the field of digital security. You will be part of a team of motivated international specialists, where knowledge exchange is highly valued.

At Bureau Veritas Cybersecurity, we provide an environment for you to develop your talents and stimulate your professional growth. Together, we work to safeguard the security and integrity of valuable data while facing the challenges of the ever-evolving digital world.

Bureau Veritas Cybersecurity is a fast-growing company with ambitious goals. You will have the opportunity to grow along with us and shape your career allowing you to become an expert in your field.
In terms of content, we offer you a diverse portfolio of exciting clients and projects. We are part of Bureau Veritas, which means that international opportunities are expanding, both for project work and for advancing your career.

Program Manager Cybersecurity - Strategic Accounts
postings.description:
Program Manager Cybersecurity - Strategic Accounts

The digitization of our society is proceeding at lightning speed. Software, systems and digital networks are everywhere and increasingly interconnected. Organizations and society lean heavily on these technologies. But while our dependence grows, so does the threat: cybercrime is on the rise and poses a risk to organizations as well as to the functioning of our society. Therefore, it is more important than ever to better protect our digital assets and systems.

At Bureau Veritas Cybersecurity, we are committed to performing just that. Our mission is to be our clients' Expert Partner a trusted partner that helps companies and public organizations understand risk, strengthen their resilience and comply with increasingly stringent standards and regulations. With more than 200 cybersecurity professionals, we offer services that encompass people, process and technology: from awareness training and social engineering to penetration testing, security consulting and compliance.

As a Program Manager, you'll lead cybersecurity programs that bring together multiple related projects, all aimed at helping our clients achieve their strategic goals. We deliver services through an approach that strengthens our clients' cyber resilience across people, processes, and technology.

In this role, you’ll coordinate and manage large-scale client programs, each with an annual turnover exceeding €800K, and act as the primary advisor for our clients. You'll collaborate closely with various stakeholders, including CISO’s, IT Managers, Security Officers, and board members. Your main goal is to ensure high-quality project outcomes and maximize client satisfaction.

You will be part of a team spread across Europe. The team is all about collaboration and an entrepreneurial mindset. We value face-to-face connections and meet quarterly in different European cities to strategize, bond, and grow together.

What will you do as our Program Manager:

- Assessment: analyze clients' cybersecurity needs and develop strategies and solutions accordingly;
- Strategic Alignment: ensure that cybersecurity projects are aligned with overall business goals and strategies. This involves understanding the client’s business and objectives;
- Strategy: develop security roadmaps for clients with the goal of delivering multidisciplinary services in a business partner role to these clients;
- Stakeholder Management: Building and maintaining relationships with key stakeholders across different business units. This includes regular communication and collaboration to ensure cybersecurity efforts support business needs;
- Program management: coordinate and oversee the projects within the program and possibly manage projects yourself. This includes planning, projects oversight, program governance, resource optimization across projects and reporting;
- Collaboration: engage with internal and external stakeholders to deliver high-quality services and ensure client satisfaction, aiming to establish a long-term relationship with the client;
- Subject matter expertise: contribute content-wise to the sales of programs and projects through translating technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders during sales processes;
- Team development: coach, guide and motivate consultants working on projects in the program(s) you are responsible for, and keep close contact with team leads in the organization to ensure that consultants work on projects with enjoyment and strength.

You are a Program Manager with:

- Relevant experience as a program manager (you may be PMP or PRINCE2 certified);
- Experience in cybersecurity, preferably in a client-oriented role, demonstrating a deep understanding of client needs and challenges;
- Familiarity with cybersecurity directives (NIS2, CRA), information security frameworks (ISO 27001, NIST CSF), and product security standards (IEC 62443), with hands-on implementation experience;
- Strong commercial skills, with the ability to identify opportunities and convert them into successful assignments;
- Experience managing teams, including coaching and mentoring team members to achieve their potential;
- Cross-cultural and international team management expertise for geographically distributed European operations;
- The ability to align cybersecurity initiatives with broader business objectives and strategies.

What can you expect from us?

At Bureau Veritas Cybersecurity you work in an environment where trust, expertise and social impact are key. We believe that you can really make a difference when you get the space to deepen your knowledge and actively contribute to a safer digital society. What does that look like in practice?

Impactful growth: The cybersecurity division of Bureau Veritas is rapidly growing, and you will have the chance to grow along with it. Whether it's about taking on more responsibilities, increasing your visibility within and outside the organization, or pursuing training and education, your career development is a priority.

Growth at Bureau Veritas Cybersecurity occurs also by participating in projects that have a real impact on society. Whether protecting smart devices from hacking attempts or performing an IT audit for the government, you'll build your skills while making a difference. You'll receive support through clear growth paths, regular performance reviews and the opportunity for active learning.

Working with a diverse client portfolio: Our clients come from many industries and contexts, but have one thing in common: they rely on our expertise to meet security and compliance requirements and build cyber resilience. In your role, you'll help protect people, processes and technology within IT, OT and IoT environments, supporting clients in identifying risks and addressing them with confidence.

Work within a highly skilled community: Cybersecurity does not stop at national borders, and so does the way we work. With teams around the world, you'll work with colleagues from different countries, disciplines and cultures, connected by a shared commitment to quality and integrity. We share knowledge, learn from each other and develop new solutions together, supported by initiatives such as our R&D programs and hands-on test labs.

A culture of respect, connection and well-being: We actively pursue a safe, inclusive and positive work environment. Our values define how we collaborate, give feedback and assess performance. We support well-being and team bonding through team activities, access to OpenUp and by encouraging a healthy work-life balance with flexible work options.

We like to celebrate successes and creating a good work environment. We regularly organize fun activities, ranging from annual ski trips to various wine and beer tastings, sailing trips, barbecues, and more. Team building is important for us.

Are you the Program Manager we are looking for?

We also welcome exceptional mid-level professionals who demonstrate strong project management fundamentals, hands-on cybersecurity implementation experience, and a genuine commitment to developing into strategic program leadership roles.

SALES SUPPORT CONSULTANT

Bureau Veritas Cybersecurity Europe is the expert partner in the field of cybersecurity. We are looking for a Sales Support Consultant to join our Cyber Physical (CyPhy) Group.

We work with various international customers with the aim to obtain new and interesting projects for our Cyber Physical (Industrial Security and Product Security) team. As our Sales Support Consultant, you will take ownership of multiple opportunities in parallel, ensuring timely delivery of high-quality proposals aligned with customer requirements and sales timelines. You will define and understand the scope of the requested work, and draft convincing proposals for our customers. You will act as the key bridge between sales and technical teams, translating customer needs into clear, deliverable cybersecurity solutions. In this role, you will coordinate closely with international delivery teams to define scope, validate effort estimates, and ensure a smooth handover from sales to execution.

You will be expected to work independently and proactively managing your workload and priorities, while maintaining a strong eye for detail to ensure accuracy and quality in all deliverables. You will also actively track and manage opportunities, customer interactions, and proposal progress within CRM systems such as Salesforce.
In addition to your technical contribution, you will play an important role in the commercial success of the business. You will contribute to the development of competitive, high-quality offers while balancing customer expectations with delivery feasibility. Furthermore, you will help improve and standardise sales processes, proposal templates, and presales best practices, contributing to a more structured and scalable way of working within the organisation.

As our Sales Support Consultant you will:
• Respond to the functional and technical elements of tender documents, such as RFIs and RFPs;
• Work closely with the technical team to understand the contents of complex commercial requests and to write accurate, convincing proposals
• Develop relevant presales material, e.g. sales proposal templates, leaflets, business cases, value propositions
• Work closely with the sales team to develop and continually improve working practices, best practices, presales processes, customer focused slide-decks, etc.;
• Write and deliver excellent presentations (business focused and technical focused);

You will be responsible for actively driving and managing the technology evaluation stage of the sales process and working in conjunction with the sales team as the key technical advisor. You will help identify all technical issues of our customers to assure complete customer satisfaction through all stages of the sales process, and you are responsible to establish and maintain strong relationships throughout the sales cycle with our customer's technical staff.

As our Sales Support Consultant you have:
• a completed bachelor or master’s degree (preferably in Computer Science, Information Security or a similar field);
• ideally relevant technical work experience ideally in cybersecurity/security testing and/or certification of embedded products to could act as a technical advisor in the sales process;
• ideally a pre-sales/inside sales professional with prior knowledge of the bidding process and experience with CRM tools such as Salesforce;
• excellent oral and written communication skills in both Dutch and English;
• fluency in another European language ideally Danish is a big plus;
• a proactive personality with a commercial mindset ;
• a reliable sales professional who has an eye for detail when it comes to crafting proposals.

At Bureau Veritas Cybersecurity you will have:

In terms of content, we offer you a very diverse portfolio of customers and customer projects. We are an organization with a technical security heart and we provide high-quality services in the field of digital security. You will join a team of motivated technical and sales professionals and knowledge exchange is our top priority.

Bureau Veritas Cybersecurity is a fast-growing company with ambition. We are an organization with people who share that drive and ambition to reach for the stars. Especially in the collaboration with Bureau Veritas, new (international) opportunities for extreme growth are on the table for our ambitious and skilled team members to further scale up our team. Therefore, you have the opportunity to grow and shape your career.

This role offers strong exposure to clients across various industries, including energy, manufacturing, and mobility. You will have the opportunity to build expertise in key cybersecurity domains such as OT Security, Product Security, and relevant regulatory frameworks and international standards including NIS2, CRA, ISO 27001 and IEC 62443. Working in a dynamic and growing environment, you will collaborate with diverse teams across regions and have clear opportunities to grow into roles such as Account Manager, Solution Consultant, or Sales Lead.

We offer:
Compensation: a gross salary between €3600 and €4000 per month based on fulltime employment and depending on your skills, educational background and work experience
Connectivity allowance: a fixed net allowance of €100,- per month (based on a 40-hour workweek) for internet and telephone.
Employee vitality: We realise that exercise boosts health, mood, and concentration—so we support it with a €30 contribution out of your gross monthly salary (tax efficient!) with choices of sports subscriptions via Bedrijfsfitness NL.
Holidays: 28 days (based on a 40-hour work week) and the option to buy 10 extra holidays.
Hybrid working: remote working and working abroad policy. You can work from another country for a maximum of 2 months per calendar year.
Learning & development: knowledge sharing is essential to our quality. Every service we deliver is built on the expertise of our team. Our training policy not only focuses on learning new things but can also helps you get important certifications to boost your skills and qualifications. We believe in tailored training – so you will get to discuss with your manager and together make a training plan based on both your needs and ours.
Mobility: our mobility policy offers flexible options designed to make commuting and business travel efficient, fair, and cost-conscious. You receive an NS Business Card. If you do not travel by public transport, you receive a compensation of €0.28 per km for commute and for business travel.
Pension: each month, the employee and BV Cyber commit respectively 5% and 6% of the pensionable salary individually, totalling 11%, to be invested in a life cycle fund. In addition to the standard contributions made by BV Cyber and the employee, there is also flexibility to opt for voluntary additional contributions on a monthly or yearly basis.
Performance Bonus: As part of the Inside Sales team, you will be assigned a team target linked to a bonus scheme. This bonus can amount to up to 16% of your annual salary if the team achieves its target.
Team Spirit: you achieve and celebrate success together. We support team-building activities such as the ski trip, a sailing event, Cyber Kart Cup, and other initiatives.
Wellbeing: Our policy is built on three core pillars: prevention, early identification, and meaningful support. We're committed to creating a workplace where you can thrive both professionally and personally. We offer the OpenUp.com platform services for employees and family members including the Financial Wellbeing module.

postings.title: Senior Red Team Lead
postings.description:
Senior Red Team Lead

Executing complex attack campaigns is one thing; taking full control of an intelligence-driven operation at the country’s most critical organizations is a skill in its own right.

We’re looking for an experienced Red Team Lead who maintains a big-picture perspective where it matters most.
In this role, you’ll have operational and technical leadership over TIBER, TLPT, and other Red and Purple Teaming assessments within the banking sector, healthcare, government, and critical infrastructure sectors. You’ll lead specialists at the intersection of social engineering, software development, exploitation, and OT, and serve as a trusted advisor to boards of directors and CISOs. You know how to help Blue Teams learn as much as possible from an operation while simultaneously elevating our offensive security capabilities and methodology to the next level.

What will you be performing?

- Ultimate responsibility for Red and Purple Teaming assessments: You will lead large- and small-scale, intelligence-driven assessments (such as Red Teaming, TIBER-EU/NL, and DORA TLPT) from initiation and threat modeling through to the final reporting and replay phase.
Operational leadership: You’ll manage multidisciplinary teams (social engineers, red teamers, exploit specialists) and get hands-on yourself during complex phases such as advanced evasion or initial access.
- Scenario and Risk Management: You translate Targeted Threat Intelligence (TTI) into credible MITRE ATT&CK attack scenarios and, during the operation, closely monitor the Rules of Engagement and operational risks in collaboration with the Control Team.
- Strategic Sparring Partner: You serve as a Trusted Advisor and primary point of contact for CISOs, executive management, and regulators, translating complex technical risks into strategic decision-making insights.
- Maximizing Impact Through Purple Teaming: After the active phase, you lead the replay workshops and help Blue Teams and SOC/detection engineers measurably improve their detection and response times.
- Quality Assurance: You review deliverables and reports to ensure their content is irrefutable and directly drives action.
- Mentoring: You coach operators on their technical skills and tradecraft, continuously raising the team’s overall level.
- R&D and Innovation: You’ll drive the development of custom tools, C2 infrastructure, and research into new attack techniques to ensure we’re always one step ahead of threats.

Your Profile

- Extensive experience in Offensive Security, Red Teaming, or Adversary Simulation.
- A proven track record in leading (regulated) adversary simulations (TIBER-NL/EU, TLPT, ART) from scoping to replay.
- Experience with stakeholder management and presenting results to management and executive-level audiences.
- Technical expertise in enterprise and cloud infrastructures (Windows/Linux, hybrid AD/Entra ID, AWS/Azure), C2 tradecraft, and advanced evasion.
- Experience with risk management, rules of engagement, and live de-confliction during active operations.
- Strong advisory skills at the management and executive levels (CISO, Board) and the ability to clearly convey impact in Dutch and English.
- Relevant certifications (e.g., OSEP, CRTE/CRTO II, GXPN, or equivalent).
- The ability to successfully complete a screening or security clearance for work in critical and financial infrastructure.

What can you expect from us?

Together with your offensive security colleagues, you’ll tackle complex operations that truly need to be performed for critical infrastructure and the business community in the Netherlands.
Think of challenges such as:

- Gaining unauthorized access: using targeted social engineering to talk your way into highly secured control rooms.
- Deep into the core: gaining a foothold remotely in isolated, mission-critical (OT) networks.
- Staying ahead of the curve: carrying out attacks against the very latest stacks and technologies.

We give you the freedom and resources to deepen your own expertise and directly help shape the future of our services.

- Growth and leadership: As Red Team Lead, you’ll play a role in the further development of our offensive security practice. You’ll have the opportunity to coach colleagues, develop new services, and increase your visibility within the cybersecurity community through publications, conferences, and knowledge sharing.
- High-Impact Projects: You’ll work with organizations where cybersecurity is of critical importance, including financial institutions, government agencies, the healthcare sector, and critical infrastructure. Thanks to our international presence within Bureau Veritas, you’ll also have the opportunity to be involved in projects outside the Netherlands.
- Culture: At Bureau Veritas, we combine technical depth with an informal and engaged culture. We invest in knowledge sharing, collaboration, and celebrating successes. From technical knowledge sessions and hack-a-thons to ski trips, sailing trips, barbecues, and other team activities: we ensure that work remains both challenging and fun.

Would you like to lead the most advanced Red Team assignments in the Netherlands and help organizations defend themselves against cyber threats? Then we’d love to meet you.
Are you interested in this position, do you have questions, or would you like to apply? You can do so via jobs.cybersecurity@bureauveritas.com

postings.title: Senior Security Specialist - Product Security
System Administrator
postings.description:
System Administrator

Are you a System Administrator who enjoys providing solutions for your colleagues engaged in highly specialized IT security investigations? Are you interested in cybersecurity and do you understand the high security standards we must meet as a leading organization?

To strengthen the Bureau Veritas Cybersecurity IT team, we are looking for a System Administrator. The team works both remotely and from our offices in Amsterdam and Eindhoven.
Our IT organization is characterized by numerous internally hosted and/or developed applications used by employees worldwide, which must be both maintained and efficiently further developed.

This position requires a Certificate of Good Conduct (VOG) and an MIVD B security clearance. If you do not yet have these, a screening process will follow after signing the employment contract. You may not start in this role until your screening has been successfully completed.

As a System Administrator, you will be responsible for:

- The performance of IT systems and equipment;
- Network security, intrusion detection, monitoring, and auditing;
- Management of virtual environments based on VMware and Proxmox;
- Management of high-security (virtual) servers based on Linux and Windows;
- Second-level user support for Linux, macOS, and Windows systems;
- Design and management of office automation and IT systems, including secure (internal and external) communication, backups, and disaster recovery;
- High-security mandatory access controls;
- ISO 27001, ISO 9001, and other data protection certifications;
- Advising management on the development of our own IT environment.

You are a System Administrator with:

- At least 5 years of work experience with knowledge of various operating systems; Linux, Windows, Mac OS, and BSD are a plus.
- Knowledge of VPN technology;
- Relevant IT knowledge, possibly supported by a relevant IT degree, supplemented by relevant training and certifications;
- Programming skills to support IT processes, experience with data centers, and knowledge of virtualization technologies such as VMware and Proxmox;
- Experience with AWS and Kubernetes is a plus;
- Knowledge of technical system hardening, network security, data protection, and the development of protocols in these areas;
- A hands-on mindset;
- Strong communication skills, both verbal and written, in Dutch and English.

As a System Administrator, you have a “can-do” attitude. You take a solution-oriented approach when implementing your colleagues’ requirements and requests. You also possess the necessary resilience under pressure and a big-picture perspective to tackle projects and ad-hoc issues decisively and with a customer-first mindset.
With your clear vision of IT security and data protection, along with your personal ambition, you’ll take on the challenge of driving our company’s growth (both nationally and internationally) and addressing the associated IT architecture challenges.

What can you expect from us?

- Learning and development: At our company, you’ll work in an environment where trust, expertise, and social impact are central. We’re convinced that you can truly make a difference when you’re given the opportunity to deepen your knowledge and actively contribute to a safer digital society. Growth with us comes not only from the training we offer but also from working on challenging projects. You’ll receive support through clear career paths, regular performance reviews, and opportunities for active learning.
- Working within a highly skilled team: cybersecurity doesn’t stop at national borders, and neither does our way of working. With teams all over the world, you’ll collaborate with colleagues from different countries, disciplines, and cultures. We share knowledge, learn from one another, and develop new solutions together, supported by initiatives such as our R&D programs.
- A culture of respect, connection, and well-being: We actively strive to create a safe, inclusive, and positive work environment. Our values guide how we collaborate, provide feedback, and conduct assessments. We support well-being by providing access to OpenUp.com and by promoting a healthy work-life balance through flexible work options.
We believe in celebrating successes and creating a pleasant work environment. We regularly organize fun activities, ranging from annual ski trips to various wine and beer tastings, sailing trips, barbecues, and much more. Team building is important to us.

We offer:

- Compensation: a gross monthly salary up to €4.700,- based on fulltime employment and depending on your skills, educational background and work experience.
- Connectivity allowance: a fixed net allowance of €100,- per month (based on a 40-hour workweek) for internet and telephone.
- Employee vitality: we realise that exercise boosts health, mood, and concentration so we support it with a €30 contribution out of your gross monthly salary (tax efficient!) with choices of sports subscriptions via Bedrijfsfitness NL.
- Holidays: 28 days (based on a 40-hour work week) and the option to buy 10 extra holidays.
- Hybrid working: remote working and working abroad policy. You can work from another country for a maximum of 2 months per calendar year.
- Learning & development: knowledge sharing is essential to our quality. Eve-ry service we deliver is built on the expertise of our team. Our training policy doesn't just focus on learning new things; it also helps you get important certi-fications to boost your skills. We believe in tailored training, so you will get to discuss with your manager and together make a training plan based on both your needs and ours.
- Mobility: our mobility policy offers flexible options designed to make commuting and business travel efficient, fair, and cost-conscious. You receive an NS Business Card. If you do not travel by public transport, you receive a compensation of €0.26 per km for commute and for business travel.
- Pension: each month, the employee and BV Cyber commit respectively 5% and 6% of the pensionable salary individually, totalling 11%, to be invested in a life cycle fund. In addition to the standard contributions made by BV Cyber and the employee, there is also flexibility to opt for voluntary additional contributions on a monthly or yearly basis.
- Performance bonus: this a reflection of the individual achievements and performance and the profit of the company throughout the previous year. The bonus can amount to a month's salary.
- Team Spirit: you achieve and celebrate success together. We support team-building activities such as the ski trip, a sailing event, Cyber Kart Cup, and other initiatives.
- Wellbeing: our policy is built on three core pillars: prevention, early identification, and meaningful support. We're committed to creating a workplace where you can thrive both professionally and personally. We offer the OpenUp.com platform services for employees and family members including the Financial Wellbeing module.

Apply by sending your resume to: jobs.cybersecurity@bureauveritas.com
Questions? Feel free to ask them via the email address above!
